en: A monochrome panoramic view of a small town nestled in a valley surrounded by large mountains. In the foreground are rocky hills and a winding dirt road. The town below features tightly clustered buildings with tile roofs and at least one prominent church with a tall bell tower. The wide valley and distant mountains fill the background. At the top left of the image, printed text in Italian reads "Volano - Panorama con la Val Lagarina".
